            String s = (in.nextLine() + "_").substring(0, n + 1);
            boolean inPar = false;
            int wordsInside = 0;
            int maxOutside = 0;
            int pos = 0;

            while (pos < s.length()) {
                int delim = nextDelimiter(s, pos);
                if (delim == s.length()) {
                    break;
                }

                int len = delim - pos;
                if (len > 0) {
                    if (inPar) {
                        wordsInside++;

                        maxOutside = len;

                char c = s.charAt(delim);

                pos = delim + 1;

            out.printf("%d %d", maxOutside, wordsInside);

            int best = s.length();
            int idx = s.indexOf('_', from);
            if (idx >= 0) best = Math.min(best, idx);
            idx = s.indexOf('(', from);
            if (idx >= 0) best = Math.min(best, idx);
            idx = s.indexOf(')', from);
